name: pkg-battle-biomes

variants.style: 2D side view mobile game battle background, comic style with bold outlines and bright flat colors, flat ground strip along the bottom third where fighters stand, open sky and space above, layered scenery in the distance, no characters, no text, no user interface

subjects.battle_lava: a volcanic landscape with black rock, glowing lava rivers and smoking volcanoes in the distance
subjects.battle_gas_giant: a floating rocky platform above swirling orange and purple gas giant clouds, a huge banded planet in the sky
subjects.battle_seabed: an underwater alien seabed with sand, swaying kelp, coral and soft light rays from above
subjects.battle_cloud_islands: floating grassy islands among fluffy clouds in a bright sky, small waterfalls falling off the edges
subjects.battle_space_station: the inside of a space station hangar with metal floor plating, big windows showing stars and a planet
subjects.battle_alien_jungle: a dense alien jungle with giant glowing plants, vines and strange purple trees
subjects.battle_shipwreck: a rocky beach with a wrecked wooden pirate ship, broken masts and scattered barrels
subjects.battle_toxic_swamp: a murky toxic swamp with glowing green water, dead twisted trees and bubbling pools

negative: characters, people, text, letters, user interface, top down view, watermark, blurry, photo
